obs.Ability description:
BARRACKSTECHLABRESEARCH_STIMPACK(target: None): Every Marine and Marauder gain the Stimpack ability. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
BARRACKSTRAIN_MARAUDER(target: None): Train a Marauder, a heavily armored infantry unit that excels against armored targets with its concussive grenades, complementing Marine forces. Cost: 100 minerals, 25 vespene.
BARRACKSTRAIN_MARINE(target: None): Train a Marine, a versatile, low-cost infantry unit that provides reliable ranged damage and forms the backbone of most Terran armies. Cost: 50 minerals.
BARRACKSTRAIN_REAPER(target: None): Train a Reaper, a fast, mobile infantry unit designed for early-game harassment and scouting, capable of jumping cliffs with its jetpack. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
BUILD_REACTOR_FACTORY(target: None): Allows structure create 2 units simultaneously. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
BUILD_TECHLAB_FACTORY(target: None): Unlocks Siege Tank and is a requirement for Thor. Cost: 50 minerals, 25 vespene.
CALLDOWNMULE_CALLDOWNMULE(target: PointOrUnit): Calls down a MULE, a temporary unit with a timed life of 64 seconds that can mine minerals and repair for the Terran forces. It requires 50 energy from Orbital Command
COMMANDCENTERTRAIN_SCV(target: None): Train a SCV, a Terran worker. Cost: 50 minerals.
EFFECT_SALVAGE(target: None): Destroy a Bunker, returning 75 minerals.
ENGINEERINGBAYRESEARCH_TERRANINFANTRYARMORLEVEL1(target: None): Increase the armor of Terran infantry units (Ghost, Marauder, Reaper, Marine, SCV). Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
ENGINEERINGBAYRESEARCH_TERRANINFANTRYWEAPONSLEVEL1(target: None): Increase the damage of Terran infantry units (Ghost, Marauder, Reaper, Marine). Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
FACTORYTRAIN_HELLION(target: None): Train a Hellion, a fast harassment vehicle that incinerates light ground units in a line. Cost: 100 minerals.
FACTORYTRAIN_WIDOWMINE(target: None): Train a Widow Mine, a burrowing trap that launches a devastating missile at the first enemy ground or air unit to cross its path. Cost: 75 minerals, 25 vespene.
RESEARCH_COMBATSHIELD(target: None): Every Marine gains a Combat Shield that gives 10 hitpoints. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
RESEARCH_CONCUSSIVESHELLS(target: None): Marauders gain the Concussive Shells ability. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
RESEARCH_HISECAUTOTRACKING(target: None): Adds +1 attack range to Auto-Turrets, Missile Turrets, and Planetary Fortresses. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
RESEARCH_TERRANSTRUCTUREARMORUPGRADE(target: None): Increases the armor of the Point Defense Drone, Auto-Turret, Missile Turret, Planetary Fortress, and all other Terran structures by 2. Cost: 150 minerals, 150 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_ARMORY(target: Point): Build a Armory to unlock the Hellbat, Thor and higher-level infantry upgrades. Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_BARRACKS(target: Point): Build a Barracks to produce infantry units (Marine, Reaper, Marauder, Ghost). Cost: 150 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_BUNKER(target: Point): Build a Bunker, a static defense building. Cost: 100 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_COMMANDCENTER(target: Point): Build a Command Center, the Terran base. Cost: 400 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_ENGINEERINGBAY(target: Point): Build an Engineer Bay to unlock Missile Turret, Sensor Tower and Planetary Fortress. Cost: 125 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_FACTORY(target: Point): Build a Factory to produce mechanical ground units (Hellion, Widow Mine, Siege Tank, Hellbat, Thor) and unlock the Starport and Armory. Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_GHOSTACADEMY(target: Point): Build a Ghost Academy to unlock the Ghost unit. Cost: 150 minerals, 50 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_MISSILETURRET(target: Point): Build a Missile Turret to attack flying units. Cost: 100 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_REFINERY(target: Unit): Build a Refinery on a Vespene Geyser. Cost: 75 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_SENSORTOWER(target: Point): Build a Sensor Tower, which senses any approaching uncloaked, unburrowed enemy units. Cost: 125 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_STARPORT(target: Point): Build a Starport to produce air units (Viking, Medivac, Banshee, Raven, Battlecruiser). Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_SUPPLYDEPOT(target: Point): Build a Supply Depot to increase 8 supplies and unlock Barracks. Cost: 100 minerals.

obs.Ability description:
BARRACKSTECHLABRESEARCH_STIMPACK(target: None): Every Marine and Marauder gain the Stimpack ability. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
BARRACKSTRAIN_MARAUDER(target: None): Train a Marauder, a heavily armored infantry unit that excels against armored targets with its concussive grenades, complementing Marine forces. Cost: 100 minerals, 25 vespene.
BARRACKSTRAIN_MARINE(target: None): Train a Marine, a versatile, low-cost infantry unit that provides reliable ranged damage and forms the backbone of most Terran armies. Cost: 50 minerals.
BARRACKSTRAIN_REAPER(target: None): Train a Reaper, a fast, mobile infantry unit designed for early-game harassment and scouting, capable of jumping cliffs with its jetpack. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
BUILD_REACTOR_FACTORY(target: None): Allows structure create 2 units simultaneously. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
BUILD_TECHLAB_FACTORY(target: None): Unlocks Siege Tank and is a requirement for Thor. Cost: 50 minerals, 25 vespene.
CALLDOWNMULE_CALLDOWNMULE(target: PointOrUnit): Calls down a MULE, a temporary unit with a timed life of 64 seconds that can mine minerals and repair for the Terran forces. It requires 50 energy from Orbital Command
COMMANDCENTERTRAIN_SCV(target: None): Train a SCV, a Terran worker. Cost: 50 minerals.
EFFECT_SALVAGE(target: None): Destroy a Bunker, returning 75 minerals.
ENGINEERINGBAYRESEARCH_TERRANINFANTRYARMORLEVEL1(target: None): Increase the armor of Terran infantry units (Ghost, Marauder, Reaper, Marine, SCV). Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
ENGINEERINGBAYRESEARCH_TERRANINFANTRYWEAPONSLEVEL1(target: None): Increase the damage of Terran infantry units (Ghost, Marauder, Reaper, Marine). Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
FACTORYTRAIN_HELLION(target: None): Train a Hellion, a fast harassment vehicle that incinerates light ground units in a line. Cost: 100 minerals.
FACTORYTRAIN_WIDOWMINE(target: None): Train a Widow Mine, a burrowing trap that launches a devastating missile at the first enemy ground or air unit to cross its path. Cost: 75 minerals, 25 vespene.
RESEARCH_COMBATSHIELD(target: None): Every Marine gains a Combat Shield that gives 10 hitpoints. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
RESEARCH_CONCUSSIVESHELLS(target: None): Marauders gain the Concussive Shells ability. Cost: 50 minerals, 50 vespene.
RESEARCH_HISECAUTOTRACKING(target: None): Adds +1 attack range to Auto-Turrets, Missile Turrets, and Planetary Fortresses. Cost: 100 minerals, 100 vespene.
RESEARCH_TERRANSTRUCTUREARMORUPGRADE(target: None): Increases the armor of the Point Defense Drone, Auto-Turret, Missile Turret, Planetary Fortress, and all other Terran structures by 2. Cost: 150 minerals, 150 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_ARMORY(target: Point): Build a Armory to unlock the Hellbat, Thor and higher-level infantry upgrades. Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_BARRACKS(target: Point): Build a Barracks to produce infantry units (Marine, Reaper, Marauder, Ghost). Cost: 150 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_BUNKER(target: Point): Build a Bunker, a static defense building. Cost: 100 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_COMMANDCENTER(target: Point): Build a Command Center, the Terran base. Cost: 400 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_ENGINEERINGBAY(target: Point): Build an Engineer Bay to unlock Missile Turret, Sensor Tower and Planetary Fortress. Cost: 125 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_FACTORY(target: Point): Build a Factory to produce mechanical ground units (Hellion, Widow Mine, Siege Tank, Hellbat, Thor) and unlock the Starport and Armory. Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_GHOSTACADEMY(target: Point): Build a Ghost Academy to unlock the Ghost unit. Cost: 150 minerals, 50 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_MISSILETURRET(target: Point): Build a Missile Turret to attack flying units. Cost: 100 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_REFINERY(target: Unit): Build a Refinery on a Vespene Geyser. Cost: 75 minerals.
TERRANBUILD_SENSORTOWER(target: Point): Build a Sensor Tower, which senses any approaching uncloaked, unburrowed enemy units. Cost: 125 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_STARPORT(target: Point): Build a Starport to produce air units (Viking, Medivac, Banshee, Raven, Battlecruiser). Cost: 150 minerals, 100 vespene.
TERRANBUILD_SUPPLYDEPOT(target: Point): Build a Supply Depot to increase 8 supplies and unlock Barracks. Cost: 100 minerals.
